_what: Board POSITION verified against nflverse's 2025 roster release, joined on `sleeper_id` — a direct key, so no name matching and no fuzzy join.
_why: Position decides which lineup slot a player can fill and which replacement baseline prices him, so a single mislabel distorts VORP for TWO positions at once. Nothing in the build checks it against an outside source; every internal field (pos_rank, tier, replacement) is derived FROM position, so internal consistency cannot detect it.
_note: 37 unjoined rows are ALL rookies (years_exp 0), which have no 2025 roster row by definition — an explained absence, not a gap in the check. 17 of them are team DEF units, which carry no sleeper_id.
